title: Wiemer arrow link
description: A quiet text link followed by a small outlined circle with an arrow. On hover the arrow rolls out to the right and a fresh one rolls in from the left (0.3s, a soft ease-out).
notes: takes the colour of its surroundings (currentColor), so it works on photos and on the orange band
name: wiemer-arrow-link

props.name: size
props.description: md: 15px (default) · lg: 17px, the header size on wide screens
